name: vscode-dap-dbgeng
description: Debug native Windows code - C and C++ programs, services, and even the Windows kernel - straight from VS Code, using the same engine that powers WinDbg.

dap-dbgeng.adapterPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to a `dap-dbgeng.exe` adapter to use instead of the one bundled with the extension. Leave empty to use the bundled adapter. A `program` set in a launch configuration takes precedence over this setting.

program.description: Path to the executable to launch. Optional when the CMake Tools extension is installed and a launch target is selected - the adapter then uses CMake Tools' launch target.

args.description: Command-line arguments for the target: a single string, or an array of arguments.

dbgengPath.description: Optional path to dbgeng.dll. When omitted, the adapter uses a dbgeng.dll bundled next to it or the installed Windows SDK Debugging Tools, and errors if none is found.

connectionString.description: Optional dbgsrv process-server string, e.g. 'tcp:port=5005,server=HOST'. When set, the process is created on that server's machine: 'program' and 'cwd' are then paths on the target. Run 'dbgsrv -t tcp:port=5005' on the target, or add an Ensure-ProcessServer.ps1 command to the 'target.hooks.beforeSession' hook to start it automatically.

cwd.description: Working directory for the launched process. Defaults to the program's directory when omitted.

target.description: Command hooks around the session, run by the extension (the adapter ignores this). Each hook is an ordered list of PowerShell command lines bound to a session-lifecycle moment. The bundled general-purpose scripts (Sign-Driver.ps1, Deploy-Binary.ps1, Start/Stop-RemoteService.ps1, Ensure-ProcessServer.ps1) are the recommended building blocks, reachable via ${dbgengScripts} here or ${command:dap-dbgeng.scriptsPath} anywhere else (e.g. tasks.json). Tokens: ${dbgengScripts}, ${host}. Commands signal failure by throwing or exiting non-zero.

host.description: The value of the ${host} token in hook commands - typically the SSH destination the bundled scripts take as -HostName, e.g. 'user@host'.

beforeSession.description: After the preLaunchTask, before the debug adapter starts - sign, deploy, ensure dbgsrv here. A failure aborts the session.

onAttachRequest.description: When the attach request goes out. Start a user-mode service here, so the adapter's 'processName' poll finds the spawning process.

afterConfigurationDone.description: Breakpoints are armed. Start a kernel driver service here, so a DriverEntry breakpoint hits.

afterSessionEnd.description: The session ended - teardown (stop services). Failures are logged, not surfaced.

sources.description: Source directories to search when resolving source files.

stopAtEntry.description: Break at the program entry point after launch. When false (the default), the adapter resumes the target after configurationDone.

trace.description: Optional path to record the DAP session to, for creating replay fixtures, e.g. '${workspaceFolder}/recordings/session.json'. Omit to disable tracing.

processId.description: The system process ID to attach to (for remote attach, the PID on the machine running dbgsrv). Set to "${command:dap-dbgeng.pickProcess}" to choose interactively at debug time; the picker lists local processes, or processes on the dbgsrv host when 'connectionString' is set.

processName.description: Attach by executable name, e.g. 'myservice.exe', instead of 'processId'. The adapter polls until a matching process appears (locally, or on the dbgsrv host when 'connectionString' is set) - made for processes that are just spawning, like a service being started.

processNameTimeout.description: How long to wait (milliseconds) for 'processName' to appear before the attach fails.

dumpFile.description: Path to a crash dump (.dmp) to open instead of attaching to a live process. Mutually exclusive with 'processId'.

connectionString.description: Remote connection string. For user-mode remote attach (with 'processId'), a dbgsrv process-server string, e.g. 'tcp:port=5005,server=HOST' (run 'dbgsrv -t tcp:port=5005' on the target). When 'kernel' is true, a kernel transport instead, e.g. 'net:port=50000,key=...' or 'com:pipe,port=\\.\pipe\kd,resets=0,reconnect'. Omit for local attach.

kernel.description: Set to true for kernel debugging; 'connectionString' is then interpreted as the kernel transport. Requires a target configured for kernel debugging (e.g. 'bcdedit /debug on').

dbgengPath.description: Optional path to dbgeng.dll. When omitted, the adapter uses a dbgeng.dll bundled next to it or the installed Windows SDK Debugging Tools, and errors if none is found.

sources.description: Source directories to search when resolving source files.

stopAtEntry.description: Break in immediately after attaching. When false, the adapter resumes the target after configurationDone instead of forcing a stop.

trace.description: Optional path to record the DAP session to, for creating replay fixtures, e.g. '${workspaceFolder}/recordings/attach.session.json'. Omit to disable tracing.

target.description: Command hooks around the session, run by the extension (the adapter ignores this). Each hook is an ordered list of PowerShell command lines bound to a session-lifecycle moment. The bundled general-purpose scripts (Sign-Driver.ps1, Deploy-Binary.ps1, Start/Stop-RemoteService.ps1, Ensure-ProcessServer.ps1) are the recommended building blocks, reachable via ${dbgengScripts} here or ${command:dap-dbgeng.scriptsPath} anywhere else (e.g. tasks.json). Tokens: ${dbgengScripts}, ${host}. Commands signal failure by throwing or exiting non-zero.

host.description: The value of the ${host} token in hook commands - typically the SSH destination the bundled scripts take as -HostName, e.g. 'user@host'.

beforeSession.description: After the preLaunchTask, before the debug adapter starts - sign, deploy, ensure dbgsrv here. A failure aborts the session.

onAttachRequest.description: When the attach request goes out. Start a user-mode service here, so the adapter's 'processName' poll finds the spawning process.

afterConfigurationDone.description: Breakpoints are armed. Start a kernel driver service here, so a DriverEntry breakpoint hits.

afterSessionEnd.description: The session ended - teardown (stop services). Failures are logged, not surfaced.

configurationSnippets.label: dbgeng: Kernel driver (deploy + start on F5)
configurationSnippets.description: Attach over KDNET; hooks sign and deploy the driver, then start its registered service once breakpoints are armed.

configurationSnippets.label: dbgeng: Remote service (deploy + start + attach by name)
configurationSnippets.description: Attach by process name via dbgsrv; hooks deploy the service binary, ensure dbgsrv, and start the service as the attach goes out.
